rca_of_issue: test_bingo_night_regression failure RCA: 'organise a bingo night on Friday at 6pm' sent as follow-up turn returns state=null, draft=null, extracted={confidence:{}} with reply 'What would you like to change on Coffee Catch-Up?'. Diagnosis: the event-EDIT intent classifier (mcgs_module/event_edit/match path) intercepts the message and fuzzy-matches it against this member's existing 'Coffee Catch-Up' event, short-circuiting the normal composer pipeline. The B1 NAMING rule and Haiku extractor never run because the message is routed through the edit-flow. Reproduction: login member@friendplace.com.au → POST /api/mcgs/george/event/start → POST .../turn with the bingo text → observe draft=null and edit-flow reply. Mitigation: OUT OF SCOPE for this strictly-bug-fix build; flag only. The primary B1 target (cake stall) is unaffected because no existing event fuzzy-matches 'cake stall'.
